ModMetaData.name: Meals at Work
ModMetaData.author: CH4AcKO3
ModMetaData.description: Eat a carried meal at 80% work speed, or automatically take a Lunch Break while crafting. Hungry pawns can start their next crafting job and order a meal during any stage of that job. Haulers deliver directly to the recipient's inventory. Orders survive workstation departures and courier interruptions, with a fixed two-hour default lifetime and no repeated ordering after a timeout during the same hunger episode. Shared reservations protect unfinished work and restore progress after eating. Empty worktables can also serve as dining tables; adding a bill does not interrupt an existing meal. Eating at a workstation gives an optional -1 mood penalty for one hour. Supports RimWorld 1.6 and 简体中文.
